title: Linearity of the affine symmetric degree-one section
statement: For a scheme S, a quasi-coherent module E, and an affine open U, the function sending m in E(U) to iota(m)/1 in the actual degree-one twist on Proj(Sym(E(U))) is O_S(U)-linear. The target scalar action is the one obtained by pushforward along the chart inclusion and the relative Proj structural map. The formula holds for every proof of degree-one membership. This is an absolute-chart calculation and asserts neither a descended sheaf nor a global morphism.

source.place: Tags 01OB and 01NR, affine degree-one homogeneous-section map

proof.text: The degree-one generator lies in the range of iota. Evaluating unitToTwist(iota(m)) at 1 gives iota(m)/1 at every point. Additivity follows pointwise from additivity of iota and localization.
The base coefficient r acts by algebraMap(r)/1 in the localization. Linearity of iota and multiplicativity of localization give the scalar identity pointwise; bundle these identities as a linear map.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_generator_linear
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] (U : S.affineOpens) :
    ∃ t : E.val.obj (op U.1) →ₗ[Γ(S, U.1)]
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjι U)).obj
          (Proj.twist ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).grading U) 1))).val.obj
        (op U.1),
      ∀ (m : E.val.obj (op U.1))
        (hm : SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(S, U.1) (E.val.obj (op U.1)) m ∈
          (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).grading U 1),
        t m = (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).twistChartFraction U
          ⟨SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(S, U.1) (E.val.obj (op U.1)) m, hm⟩
